# Monarch

> Monarch builds custom CRM, local lead discovery, multi-channel outreach, and private AI systems for service businesses — so every call, text, and email moves a real opportunity forward.

## What Monarch does
- Custom CRM systems.
- Local lead discovery.
- Multi-channel outreach (calls, texts, email).
- Private AI systems for service businesses.
